candidate_system.published_network_scope: daily flower-visit networks from 2022-2024 using the three numerically dominant bee species Apis mellifera, Anthophora dispar and Bombus terrestris

independence_boundary: Giannutri and its daily flower-visitor networks were not used in ABM v4, v5 or v6 construction, Ogasawara diagnosis, or Menorca falsification. This candidate can therefore provide a new empirical system, but the published network analysis is explicitly a three-focal-bee network rather than a complete pollinator community. Any later v6 test must preserve that scope instead of silently treating it as a whole-community network.

required_before_any_target: recover Zenodo record metadata from the frozen record id
recover the four exact checksum-locked source/code files
inventory raw column names and row counts without calculating network metrics
identify source fields capable of preserving day/year and hive-condition grouping
do not calculate Shannon, plant niche overlap, empirical network ranges, or a v6 predictive fit
source_only_gate.blocked_rule: If exact source bytes or checksum locks fail, or if day/condition/species/plant interaction structure cannot be recovered from source-native files, block before target inspection. Do not use published summary network indices or reconstruct quantitative matrices from figures.

prohibited_before_source_admission: expand the three-focal-bee published network to all pollinators without a separately frozen source rule
select only HB+ or HB- days based on network values
pool days differently after inspecting target values
